blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Philippine Army’s 6th Infantry (Kampilan) Division and Joint Task Force Central (JTFC) on Wednesday recognized soldiers and police officers who spearheaded security operations during the historic opening of the first elected Bangsamoro parliament and the election of the region’s first chief minister. The event was graced by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., who delivered his message to the Bangsamoro before the election of Parliament officials. Maj. Gen. Edgar Catu, 6ID and JTFC commander, led the awarding ceremony at Camp Siongco, where various units of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and Philippine National Police (PNP) were […]...
